item.title: DeKalb County Georgia launches pet litter registry to make backyard breeders more accountable
item.description: DeKalb County, Georgia will officially launch the Litter Registry Ordinance on January 1, 2026 when all owners of dogs, cats and domestic rabbits will be required to register their litters within 21 days of birth.
